## Running a workshop

You need R (≥ 4.5) and RStudio. Fetch a workshop with `usethis::use_course(<zip-url>)`, then open
the `.Rproj` and `renv::restore()` — see the workshop's own page for the exact flow (both ship a
bundle of per-step projects).

## Per-cohort model

Each cohort gets its own Release (tag `coorte-AAAA`) with decks + workshop ZIPs frozen at that
point. This site always shows the **latest** rendered slides; the Release assets are the **offline,
citable snapshot**.
